title: Performance of artificial intelligence for fracture detection: an umbrella review and second-order-meta-analysis
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: AI骨折检测性能：伞形综述与二次荟萃分析
summary: 纳入50篇系统综述或荟萃分析、387项原始研究的伞形综述，二次荟萃分析合并AI骨折检测敏感度为0.897。
key_points: 纳入50篇综述、387项原始研究
21项荟萃分析纳入二次合并，重叠度仅4.31%
reason: 系统综述且纳入大量研究、结论明确，属可到7分的综述档
abstract: Abstract Fractures affect approximately 178 million people annually, and artificial intelligence (AI) tools for fracture detection are increasingly approved by regulators. We conducted an umbrella review and second-order meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD42024516414), searching six databases to 4/06/2025 for systematic reviews or meta-analyses of AI fracture detection using any imaging modality. Screening, extraction, and quality assessment were performed in duplicate. We assessed review quality using AMSTAR-2, primary-study overlap using corrected covered area, and certainty using GRADE. Fifty reviews were included (25 systematic reviews and 25 meta-analyses; 387 primary studies). Twenty-one meta-analyses (269 primary studies) contributed to second-order meta-analysis, with slight overall overlap (4.31%). Pooled AI sensitivity was 0.897 (95% CI 0.882–0.911; 95% prediction interval 0.753–0.962) and specificity 0.904 (95% CI 0.891–0.916; prediction interval 0.824 to 0.950). Comparative evidence showed no consistent differences for AI, clinicians, and AI-assisted clinicians: however, this data was sparse and inconclusive. No review reported adverse events or other safety outcomes. Certainty was very low/low for almost all outcomes; all meta-analyses were rated critically low/low on AMSTAR-2. Although published estimates suggest high diagnostic accuracy, real-world and comparative performance remain uncertain. Prospective external validation, multi-reader-multi-case studies, and randomised trials are needed before broad clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: 摘要 骨折每年影响约1.78亿人，用于骨折检测的人工智能（AI）工具正越来越多地获得监管机构批准。我们开展了一项伞状综述和二阶meta分析（PROSPERO CRD42024516414），检索了六个数据库至4/06/2025，纳入使用任何影像模态进行AI骨折检测的系统综述或meta分析。筛查、提取和质量评价均双人重复进行。我们使用AMSTAR-2评估综述质量，使用校正覆盖面积（corrected covered area）评估原始研究重叠，并使用GRADE评估证据确定性。共纳入50篇综述（25篇系统综述和25篇meta分析；387项原始研究）。21篇meta分析（269项原始研究）纳入二阶meta分析，总体重叠较小（4.31%）。合并的AI敏感度为0.897（95% CI 0.882–0.911；95%预测区间0.753–0.962），特异度为0.904（95% CI 0.891–0.916；预测区间0.824–0.950）。比较证据显示AI、临床医生和AI辅助的临床医生之间没有一致差异：然而，这些数据稀少且无定论。没有综述报告不良事件或其他安全性结局。几乎所有结局的确定性为极低/低；所有meta分析在AMSTAR-2上被评为极低/低。尽管已发表的估计提示诊断准确性高，但真实世界和比较性能仍不确定。在广泛临床采用之前，需要前瞻性外部验证、多读者多病例研究和随机试验。

title: Automation Bias and Deskilling in Radiology AI: A Confidence-stratified Triage Model for Workflow Integration.
zh_title: 放射AI的自动化偏差与技能退化
summary: 该文讨论放射科AI常态化使用带来的自动化偏差与技能退化风险，并提出置信度分层分诊模型。
key_points: AI错误输出会降低判读准确性，与经验无关
辅助收益因读片者与任务而异，撤除后表现下降
提出置信度分层分诊模型以融入工作流
reason: 同行评审观点/框架文章，提出整合模型但无实证数据，属值得一看档。
abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] Radiology is adopting artificial intelligence (AI) faster than it is studying what AI does to radiologists' perceptual expertise and interpretive skill. The question has partly shifted from whether these tools perform well on benchmark tasks to what happens to clinical judgment when use of these tools becomes routine. Two risks accompany this transition: automation bias, the tendency to follow AI suggestions without adequate scrutiny, and deskilling, the erosion of perceptual and interpretive ability through disuse, typically revealed when AI support is withdrawn. Incorrect AI output degrades accuracy regardless of experience, the benefit of assistance varies unpredictably across readers and tasks, and performance falls after AI withdrawal; neither risk has been studied longitudinally in radiology. A confidence-stratified triage model is proposed in which calibrated AI confidence, not findings alone, routes cases to low-, intermediate-, or high-confidence streams: output withheld until independent reading, shown with uncertainty signals and a checklist, or shown with random blinded audit. Demonstrated local confidence calibration is a precondition for deployment, and stream thresholds and audit rates should be weighted by task and potential clinical harm, not error probability alone. Rather than applying one workflow to every case, the model redistributes radiologist attention to where AI error is most likely and most consequential, operationalizing four principles: keeping the radiologist in the decision loop, making AI uncertainty visible, inserting targeted cognitive friction, and governing the human-AI interaction as a system. A research agenda to determine whether these countermeasures reduce automation bias and skill erosion in practice is also proposed.
zh_abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] 放射学采用人工智能（AI）的速度，快于研究AI对放射科医师感知专长和判读技能所产生影响的速度。问题已部分从这些工具是否在基准任务上表现良好，转向当这些工具的使用成为常规时临床判断会发生什么。这一转变伴随两种风险：自动化偏差（automation bias），即在没有充分审查的情况下遵循AI建议的倾向；以及去技能化（deskilling），即因不使用而导致感知和判读能力侵蚀，通常在AI支持被撤除时显现。错误的AI输出会降低准确性，无论经验如何；辅助的获益在不同阅片者和任务之间不可预测地变化；并且在AI撤除后表现下降；这两种风险均未在放射学中进行纵向研究。提出一种置信度分层分诊模型，其中经过校准的AI置信度而非仅依据发现，将病例分流至低、中、高置信度流程：输出暂不提供直至完成独立判读；在显示不确定性信号和清单的情况下显示输出；或在随机盲法审核下显示输出。已证明的本地置信度校准是部署的前提，流程阈值和审核率应根据任务和潜在临床危害加权，而非仅依据错误概率。该模型不是对每个病例应用一种工作流程，而是将放射科医师的注意力重新分配到AI错误最可能且最具后果的地方，并将四项原则操作化：让放射科医师保持在决策环路中、使AI不确定性可见、插入有针对性的认知摩擦，以及将人-AI交互作为一个系统进行治理。还提出了一个研究议程，以确定这些对策在实践中是否减少自动化偏差和技能侵蚀。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To compare patient trust in educational health contentand the physician providing it, when authorship is attributed to a physician or generative artificial intelligence (AI). In a preregistered randomized, parallel survey study, participants read a health education article. Individuals were randomized to 1 of 4 conditions, attributing authorship of an identical article to (1) a physician author, (2) generative AI, (3) a physician assisted by AI (hybrid authorship), or (4) no author. Pregnant or postpartum English-speaking US adults (n = 400) were recruited in August-October 2025 via an online survey panel. Eighty percent passed timing and attention checks. Participants rated article engagement, content trust, and trust in the (hypothetical) recommending physician with Likert-scales. Bonferroni corrections were applied to post hoc pairwise comparisons (α = 0.05). Among participants who correctly recalled authorship (n = 195), AI-only authorship was associated with lower trust in content (mean, 9.43 vs 11.11; P = .001) and the recommending physician (mean, 8.93 vs 10.84; P = .03) compared with physician-only authorship, while hybrid authorship did not differ significantly from physician-only authorship for either outcome (content: P = .08; physician: P > .99). Sensitivity analyses including all participants (n = 321) were generally consistent with the primary findings. Engagement did not differ significantly across conditions in the primary analytic sample. As generative AI becomes increasingly integrated into clinical care, how AI involvement and physician oversight are communicated to patients could have important implications for patient trust. AI authorship was associated with reduced trust in patient-facing education despite identical, clinician-written content.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 在作者署名归属于医生或生成式人工智能（AI）时，比较患者对教育性健康内容及提供该内容的医生的信任。在一项预注册的随机、平行调查研究中，参与者阅读一篇健康教育文章。个体被随机分配到4种条件之一，将同一篇文章的作者署名归于（1）医生作者、（2）生成式AI、（3）由AI协助的医生（混合署名）或（4）无作者。妊娠期或产后英语美国成年人（n = 400）于2025年8月至10月通过在线调查面板招募。80%通过了时间与注意力检查。参与者使用Likert量表对文章参与度、内容信任以及对（假设的）推荐医生的信任进行评分。事后两两比较采用Bonferroni校正（α = 0.05）。在正确回忆作者身份的参与者（n = 195）中，与仅医生署名相比，仅AI署名与对内容的信任较低相关（均值，9.43 vs 11.11；P = .001）以及对推荐医生的信任较低相关（均值，8.93 vs 10.84；P = .03），而混合署名在两项结局上均与仅医生署名无显著差异（内容：P = .08；医生：P > .99）。纳入所有参与者（n = 321）的敏感性分析总体上与主要发现一致。在主要分析样本中，参与度在各条件间无显著差异。随着生成式AI日益融入临床护理，如何向患者传达AI参与和医生监督可能对患者信任产生重要影响。尽管内容相同且由临床医生撰写，AI署名与对面向患者教育的信任降低相关。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Second Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University, School of Medicine; conditions: Acute Ischemic Stroke; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: PHASE3; enrollment: 826; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This multicenter, prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of intravenous recombinant human prourokinase (rhPro-UK) in patients with acute ischemic stroke treated more than 4.5 hours and up to 24 hours after stroke onset, selected using a noncontrast computed tomography-based artificial intelligence (CT-AI) tissue-window algorithm. A total of 826 participants will be randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive intravenous rhPro-UK or matching placebo, in addition to guideline-recommended standard stroke care. The primary outcome is the proportion of participants achieving a modified Rankin Scale (mRS) score of 0-1 at 90 ± 7 days. Secondary outcomes include functional outcomes, changes in neurological deficits, early neurological improvement at 24 hours and 7 days, and tissue reperfusion at 24-48 hours. Safety outcomes include symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage, parenchymal hematoma, all-cause mortality, and serious systemic bleeding.

source: PubMed · Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine
zh_title: 跨模态跨数据集跨阶段的神经退行性疾病深度学习检测系统综述
summary: PRISMA 系统综述纳入 2019 年至 2026 年 4 月的 111 项研究，评估多模态深度学习用于神经退行性疾病早期预测、诊断与进展监测。

reason: 系统综述纳入研究数量较多但仅见摘要，结论细节有限，属值得一看档
abstract: [Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine] BackgroundNeurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's pose significant diagnostic challenges because they are incurable. Their symptoms often overlap with those of normal ageing and involve progressive neuronal loss. This makes early prediction, proper diagnosis, and ongoing monitoring crucial at every stage of the disease. Deep learning has become a useful tool for handling different types of data. However, the performance of these models relies heavily on the availability and variety of data, making it important to characterize datasets.ObjectiveThis PRISMA-based systematic review looks at 111 studies from 2019 to April 2026, organized into three clinical stages of neurodegenerative diseases: early prediction, diagnosis, and progression.MethodsEach study is assessed across four dimensions: data type (neuroimaging or non-neuroimaging), datasets (open-access, self-created, or hybrid), deep learning model architecture, and the use of explainable AI.ResultsMRI is the only imaging modality that spans all three stages. Speech is the most common non-neuroimaging method for diagnosis, while gait is used only for diagnosis and progression. The ADNI and PPMI datasets are the most commonly used. Self-created datasets introduce new modalities such as ECG and iPSCs, which are not found in open-access datasets. CNNs are the leading models for neuroimaging tasks, while LSTMs and RNNs capture temporal patterns in longitudinal datasets. Survival models are exclusively used for ALS and LATE. Fewer than 6% of the studies used confirmed XAI. Only 2 of the 111 studies validated their results on an independent external cohort.ConclusionThis review is the only one that covers all three disease stages across multiple neurodegenerative diseases.
zh_abstract: [Technology and Health Care（欧洲工程与医学学会官方期刊）]【背景】阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等神经退行性疾病因无法治愈而带来重大诊断挑战。其症状常与正常衰老的症状重叠，并涉及进行性神经元丢失。这使得在疾病的每个阶段进行早期预测、正确诊断和持续监测至关重要。深度学习已成为处理不同类型数据的有用工具。然而，这些模型的性能在很大程度上依赖于数据的可获得性和多样性，因此对数据集进行表征很重要。【目的】本项基于PRISMA的系统综述考察了2019年至2026年4月的111项研究，并按神经退行性疾病的三个临床阶段进行组织：早期预测、诊断和进展。【方法】每项研究均从四个维度进行评估：数据类型（神经影像或非神经影像）、数据集（开放获取、自建或混合）、深度学习模型架构，以及可解释人工智能（XAI）的使用情况。【结果】MRI是唯一涵盖全部三个阶段的影像模态。语音是诊断中最常用的非神经影像方法，而步态仅用于诊断和进展。ADNI和PPMI数据集是最常用的数据集。自建数据集引入了开放获取数据集中没有的新模态，如ECG和iPSCs。CNN是神经影像任务的主要模型，而LSTM和RNN用于捕捉纵向数据集中的时间模式。生存模型仅用于ALS和LATE。少于6%的研究使用了经确认的XAI。111项研究中仅有2项在独立外部队列上验证了其结果。【结论】本综述是唯一一项涵盖多种神经退行性疾病全部三个疾病阶段的综述。

abstract: Clinical research over electronic health records depends on derived variables whose definitions sit outside the schema, in item codes, time windows, missingness rules, and output-grain choices that change cohorts and downstream conclusions. We introduce M4Bench, 28 clinical derivation tasks across 15 task families on MIMIC-IV and eICU, to test whether AI coding agents can reproduce such derivations and how clinician-reviewed agent skills change their results. Its controls decompose the value of skills into specification completeness, delivery format, and schema familiarity. In a Docker-isolated Codex campaign (GPT 5.4 Mini and GPT 5.5), skills raise reward by 0.136 over the no-skill baseline, with 26 of 28 tasks improving. Specification completeness accounts for most of this gain: on an eight-task control subset, an operational spec alone raises reward by 0.162, and skills add only 0.024 on top, indistinguishable from zero. On a ten-task subset, decoy skills score like no skill and raw reference SQL nearly matches targeted skills, arguing against generic context or the skill format as the explanation. Schema obfuscation and restructuring preserve 86% and 70% of the skill gain (GPT 5.4 Mini, 26 MIMIC-IV tasks), a descriptive robustness check rather than a bound on memorization. A descriptive Claude Code replication on all 28 tasks (Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 4.6, 560 runs) is directionally consistent (+0.120, 21 of 28 tasks improving). These gains are partial agreement with the reference, not completed tasks: only 25 of 280 with-skill and 13 of 280 no-skill Codex runs pass every strict check, and skills barely change which rows agents return (key F1 +0.003). Skills are released as a versioned, clinician-reviewable markdown delivery format, with a family-level reference-validity audit. M4Bench releases tasks, skills, evaluation code, and sanitized per-run evidence as an open-source benchmark.
zh_abstract: 基于电子健康记录的临床研究依赖于派生变量，而这些变量的定义位于模式（schema）之外，体现在项目代码、时间窗、缺失规则以及会改变队列和下游结论的输出粒度选择中。我们提出 M4Bench，在 MIMIC-IV 和 eICU 上涵盖 15 个任务族的 28 个临床派生任务，用于检验 AI 编码智能体能否复现此类派生，以及经临床医生审核的智能体技能如何改变其结果。其对照将技能的价值分解为规范完整性、交付格式和模式熟悉度。在一项 Docker 隔离的 Codex 实验中（GPT 5.4 Mini 和 GPT 5.5），技能相较无技能基线将奖励（reward）提高 0.136，28 个任务中有 26 个得到改善。规范完整性解释了这一增益的大部分：在包含八个任务的对照子集上，仅可操作规范即使奖励提高 0.162，而技能在此基础上仅增加 0.024，与零无法区分。在包含十个任务的子集上，诱饵技能的得分与无技能相当，而原始参考 SQL 几乎与针对性技能相当，这反对将通用上下文或技能格式作为解释。模式混淆与重构分别保留了 86% 和 70% 的技能增益（GPT 5.4 Mini，26 个 MIMIC-IV 任务），这是一项描述性稳健性检查，而非对记忆的界限。在全部 28 个任务上的描述性 Claude Code 复现（Opus 4.7 和 Sonnet 4.6，560 次运行）方向一致（+0.120，28 个任务中有 21 个得到改善）。这些增益是与参考的部分一致，而非完成任务：在 Codex 运行中，仅有 280 次有技能运行中的 25 次和 280 次无技能运行中的 13 次通过每项严格检查，且技能几乎不改变智能体返回的行（关键 F1 +0.003）。技能以版本化、可供临床医生审核的 Markdown 交付格式发布，并附有任务族级参考有效性审计。M4Bench 作为开源基准发布任务、技能、评估代码和经净化的逐次运行证据。

title: AI-Assisted Differentiation of Autoimmune Pancreatitis and Pancreatic Cancer Using EUS: A Multicenter Ambispective Study

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ruijin Hospital; conditions: Autoimmune Pancreatitis, Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC); type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 690; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Focal autoimmune pancreatitis (f-AIP) and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) exhibit substantial overlap in clinical manifestations and imaging features, posing a major diagnostic challenge in pancreatic diseases. Given the marked differences in treatment strategies and prognosis, accurate differentiation is essential to avoid unnecessary surgery and ensure timely initiation of anticancer treatment. This study aims to collect endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) images from patients with confirmed f-AIP or PDAC across multiple centers, using a previously established multicenter database. Data collected before January 2026 will be used to develop an artificial intelligence (AI) model based on EUS radiomics for differential diagnosis. Subsequently, prospectively collected data from participating centers from 2026 onward will be used for model testing and validation. The diagnostic performance of the model will be evaluated and compared with that of endoscopists with different levels of experience. Furthermore, this study will investigate the clinical value of interpretable radiomic features, with particular emphasis on challenging diagnostic scenarios, including IgG4-negative AIP, AIP with elevated carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (CA19-9) levels, and PDAC with imaging features resembling those of AIP. The ultimate goal is to provide a reliable tool for accurate, noninvasive preoperative differential diagnosis while promoting the standardization of multicenter AIP databases and the sharing and utilization of imaging data resources.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：瑞金医院；疾病：自身免疫性胰腺炎、胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）；类型：观察性；入组人数：690；状态：尚未招募] 局灶性自身免疫性胰腺炎（f-AIP）与胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）在临床表现和影像学特征方面存在显著重叠，对胰腺疾病构成重大诊断挑战。鉴于治疗策略和预后存在显著差异，准确鉴别对于避免不必要的手术并确保及时启动抗癌治疗至关重要。本研究旨在利用既往建立的多中心数据库，收集多个中心确诊f-AIP或PDAC患者的内镜超声（EUS）图像。2026年1月之前收集的数据将用于开发基于EUS影像组学的人工智能（AI）模型以进行鉴别诊断。随后，参与中心自2026年起前瞻性收集的数据将用于模型测试和验证。将评估该模型的诊断性能，并与不同经验水平的内镜医师进行比较。此外，本研究将探讨可解释影像组学特征的临床价值，特别关注具有挑战性的诊断场景，包括IgG4阴性AIP、碳水化合物抗原19-9（CA19-9）升高的AIP以及影像学特征类似AIP的PDAC。最终目标是提供一种可靠工具，用于准确、无创的术前鉴别诊断，同时促进多中心AIP数据库的标准化以及影像数据资源的共享和利用。

title: Clinical Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Management of Chronic Hepatitis B.
source: PubMed · Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology

summary: 该综述讨论AI在慢性乙型肝炎筛查、诊断、风险分层与肝癌监测等管理环节的应用空间。

abstract: [Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology] Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) burdens the healthcare system, affecting millions of individuals worldwide with a potential progression to complications such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The World Health Organization launched the chronic viral hepatitis elimination plan which aimed to eliminate chronic hepatitis B virus by 2030, yet the goal has seemed to be far from reach with the remaining few years owing to different hurdles ranging from screening strategy and diagnosis to risk stratification for antiviral treatment and HCC surveillance. To refine the management of CHB, previous studies focused on identifying the at-risk populations and predictors for adverse outcomes using conventional statistical methods. With the emerging role of artificial intelligence (AI), there is further room to improve different aspects of screening and management. For instance, generative AI, such as large language models (LLMs), has been proven to have the ability to answer different clinical questions, assisting patients' and physicians' decision on various clinical scenarios. Different machine learning and deep learning models have also been developed to assess for liver fibrosis, as well as to aid segmentation of liver structures and detection of focal liver lesions through various imaging modalities. While different AI models have shown superior performance compared to those developed through traditional statistical models, the lack of standardized datasets in training cohorts and the unresolved concerns of hallucination of false information in LLMs pose challenges on applying AI in the current management of CHB, in which further studies are required to adopt AI into daily clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology] 慢性乙型肝炎（CHB）给医疗系统带来负担，影响全球数百万个体，并可能进展为肝硬化、肝细胞癌（HCC）等并发症。世界卫生组织启动了慢性病毒性肝炎消除计划，旨在到2030年消除慢性乙型肝炎病毒，但由于从筛查策略和诊断到抗病毒治疗的风险分层和HCC监测等不同障碍，在剩余几年内该目标似乎仍遥不可及。为改进CHB的管理，既往研究侧重于使用传统统计方法识别高危人群和不良结局的预测因素。随着人工智能（AI）作用的显现，在筛查和管理的不同方面仍有进一步改进空间。例如，生成式AI，如大语言模型（LLMs），已被证明有能力回答不同临床问题，协助患者和医师在各种临床场景中做出决策。还开发了不同的机器学习和深度学习模型，用于评估肝纤维化，以及通过多种影像模态辅助肝脏结构分割和局灶性肝脏病变检测。虽然不同AI模型相比通过传统统计模型开发的模型显示出更优性能，但训练队列缺乏标准化数据集以及LLMs中虚假信息幻觉这一未解决问题，对在当前CHB管理中应用AI构成挑战，需要进一步研究以将AI纳入日常临床实践。

title: Richer database context improves LLM-generated EHR phenotyping algorithms
zh_title: 更丰富的数据库上下文提升LLM生成EHR表型算法表现
summary: 预印本评估8个公开LLM系统生成2型糖尿病表型SQL，发现提供详细码表可显著提升SQL可执行率。
key_points: 8个LLM系统生成T2DM表型SQL
有限上下文时多数输出无法直接执行
详码表使可执行率升至81.3%–100%
reason: 方法有新意、有参考表型对比，但为预印本且仅单中心EHR，属值得一看档
abstract: Objective: To evaluate large language model (LLM) generation of type 2 diabetes (T2DM) phenotyping SQL and the effect of database implementation context. Materials and Methods: Eight publicly accessible LLM-based systems generated SQL under progressively richer prompts using synthetic and University of North Carolina (UNC) Health electronic health record (EHR) data, both based on the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) model. Outputs were compared with the Electronic Medical Records and Genomics (eMERGE) T2DM reference phenotype using SQL executability, F1, positive predictive value (PPV), and recall. Results: Fewer than 55% of limited-context synthetic outputs and no limited-context UNC EHR outputs executed without modification. Detailed codebooks (L3) increased executability to 81.3% in synthetic OMOP and 100% in UNC EHR; adding sample rows (L4) increased synthetic executability to 100%. Limited-context recall was as low as 0.01, whereas high-context outputs achieved recall [≥]0.99 at synthetic L4 and >0.90 at UNC L3, although UNC PPV remained substantially lower than recall. At the highest available context levels, Beta F1 ranged from 0.72-0.99 in synthetic OMOP and 0.57-0.68 in UNC EHR; all UNC models exceeded the diagnosis-code baseline (F1=0.54). The top synthetic performer fell from F1=0.99 to 0.64 on UNC EHR. Discussion: Richer database context was associated with more consistent SQL executability and recall, while model rankings varied across datasets. Conclusion: LLMs can generate clinically meaningful T2DM phenotyping SQL when provided with sufficient database context, but limited PPV in real-world data underscores the need for local validation.
zh_abstract: 【目的】评估大语言模型（LLM）生成 2 型糖尿病（T2DM）表型 SQL 的能力，以及数据库实施情境的影响。【材料与方法】八种可公开访问的基于 LLM 的系统在逐步更丰富的提示下，使用基于观察性医疗结果合作组织（OMOP）模型的合成数据和北卡罗来纳大学（UNC）Health 电子健康记录（EHR）数据生成 SQL。将输出与电子病历与基因组学（eMERGE）T2DM 参考表型进行比较，指标包括 SQL 可执行性、F1、阳性预测值（PPV）和召回率。【结果】有限上下文的合成数据输出中不足 55% 可在未经修改的情况下执行，而有限上下文的 UNC EHR 输出中没有一项可未经修改执行。详细的代码本（L3）将可执行性提高到合成 OMOP 中的 81.3% 和 UNC EHR 中的 100%；添加样本行（L4）将合成数据可执行性提高到 100%。有限上下文的召回率低至 0.01，而高上下文输出在合成 L4 中达到召回率 ≥0.99，在 UNC L3 中 >0.90，尽管 UNC 的 PPV 仍显著低于召回率。在可获得的最高上下文水平下，Beta F1 在合成 OMOP 中范围为 0.72-0.99，在 UNC EHR 中为 0.57-0.68；所有 UNC 模型均超过诊断代码基线（F1=0.54）。表现最好的合成数据模型在 UNC EHR 上从 F1=0.99 降至 0.64。【讨论】更丰富的数据库上下文与更一致的 SQL 可执行性和召回率相关，而模型排名在不同数据集之间有所变化。【结论】当提供足够的数据库上下文时，LLM 可以生成具有临床意义的 T2DM 表型 SQL，但真实世界数据中有限的 PPV 凸显了本地验证的必要性。

title: Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis
zh_title: 本体引导多智能体可解释鉴别诊断推理
summary: arXiv预印本提出本体引导多智能体框架，模拟医师迭代推理以提升鉴别诊断可解释性。
key_points: 针对LLM依赖模式识别、依据不足的问题
本体引导多智能体复现医师迭代推理过程
目标是使诊断结论可追溯、可供临床评估
reason: 有新意的多智能体可解释方法预印本，未提供外部验证信息，属值得一看档
abstract: Effective differential diagnosis depends on well structured and unambiguous patient case descriptions, since incomplete or ambiguous clinical information readily leads to diagnostic errors and inconsistent reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promising capabilities in medical question answering and clinical reasoning; however, even when achieving competitive performance on medical benchmarks, they often rely on pattern recognition learned from training data rather than grounded clinical evidence, and can generate plausible yet unsupported diagnostic conclusions. Their reasoning remains largely opaque, making it difficult for clinicians to assess the evidence and rationale behind a given recommendation. To address this gap, we propose an ontology-guided, multiagent differential diagnosis framework that replicates the iterative reasoning process of physicians. The framework grounds diagnostic inference in a structured, expert-curated medical knowledge base, enabling interpretation of symptoms, clinical findings, or disease relationships, while decomposing diagnosis into explicit, auditable reasoning steps. This ontology-based grounding constrains inference to evidence-backed associations, reducing hallucination and improving diagnostic transparency, traceability, and consistency. The system then identifies the most discriminative missing symptoms and generates targeted follow-up questions to reduce uncertainty through a process that mirrors to clinical inquiry. Together, these components improve the reliability, explainability, and diagnostic accuracy of AI-assisted differential diagnosis. The source code is publicly available.
zh_abstract: 有效的鉴别诊断依赖于结构良好且无歧义的患者病例描述，因为不完整或模糊的临床信息很容易导致诊断错误和不一致的推理。大型语言模型（LLMs）最近在医学问答和临床推理方面显示出有前景的能力；然而，即使在医学基准测试中达到有竞争力的表现，它们也常常依赖从训练数据中学到的模式识别，而非有依据的临床证据，并可能生成看似合理但缺乏支持的诊断结论。其推理在很大程度上仍不透明，使临床医生难以评估某一推荐背后的证据和理由。为解决这一差距，我们提出了一种本体引导的多智能体鉴别诊断框架，复现医生的迭代推理过程。该框架将诊断推断建立在结构化、由专家整理的医学知识库之上，从而能够解释症状、临床发现或疾病关系，同时将诊断分解为明确、可审计的推理步骤。这种基于本体的 grounding 将推断限制在有证据支持的关联上，减少幻觉并提高诊断透明度、可追溯性和一致性。随后，系统识别最具鉴别力的缺失症状，并生成有针对性的追问问题，通过一个镜像临床询问的过程来降低不确定性。这些组件共同提高了AI辅助鉴别诊断的可靠性、可解释性和诊断准确性。源代码公开可用。

title: Decision models can offload structured clinical tasks from large language models
zh_title: 决策模型可承接大模型的结构化临床任务
summary: 预印本探索专用决策模型Jev在死亡率风险、Choosing Wisely问题与结肠癌分期任务上替代大语言模型的效果，并与五个旗舰大模型对比。
abstract: Decision models like Jev read text and return probabilities, categories, or ordinal levels, with confidence scores for the latter two, at a fraction of large language models (LLMs) cost. We explored how Jev could be integrated into clinical workflows for all these output types: mortality risk estimation, categorical Choosing-Wisely decisions for patient questions, and ordinal colon cancer staging. With standard LLM-style inputs, Jev trailed five flagship LLMs: mortality AUROC was 0.822 versus 0.837-0.846; Choosing-Wisely accuracy, 87.7% versus 98.4-100%; and staging accuracy, 45.4% versus 94.2-100%. Developer-recommended input alterations improved staging accuracy to 75.8% with medical context, 82.1% with task decomposition, and 85.8% with both. None of Jevs staging errors had full confidence. Using Jev for fully confident staging decisions and LLMs for the rest was non-inferior to each LLM alone and cut flagship LLM costs by 33-44%. Prompted as designed, decision models may efficiently share structured clinical tasks with LLMs.
key_points: 死亡率AUROC 0.822，低于LLM的0.837–0.846
标准输入下分期准确率45.4%，LLM为94.2–100%
按开发者建议改写输入后分期准确率最高达85.8%
reason: 预印本方法对比充分、含成本讨论，但无外部验证，属值得一看档
zh_abstract: 像Jev这样的决策模型读取文本并返回概率、类别或有序等级，对后两者还给出置信度分数，其成本仅为大型语言模型（LLMs）的一小部分。我们探索了如何将Jev整合到针对所有这些输出类型的临床工作流程中：死亡风险估计、针对患者问题的分类式Choosing Wisely决策，以及有序结肠癌分期。采用标准LLM风格输入时，Jev落后于五个旗舰LLM：死亡风险AUROC为0.822，而后者为0.837-0.846；Choosing Wisely准确率为87.7%，而后者为98.4-100%；分期准确率为45.4%，而后者为94.2-100%。开发者推荐的输入调整将分期准确率提高至75.8%（加入医学背景）、82.1%（任务分解）和85.8%（两者兼有）。Jev的分期错误均未具有完全置信度。将Jev用于完全置信的分期决策、LLM用于其余决策，不劣于任一LLM单独使用，并将旗舰LLM成本降低33-44%。按设计进行提示后，决策模型可与LLMs高效分担结构化临床任务。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Northwestern University; conditions: Lung Carcinoma, Lung Non-Small Cell Carcinoma, Metastatic Malignant Neoplasm in the Lung; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 34; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This clinical trial studies whether an artificial intelligence (AI) software tool called iSeg can be safely and effectively used during routine radiation treatment planning for patients with lung tumors. Typical radiation treatment planning involves physicians manually outlining the tumors to plan where the radiation therapy will be delivered. This process can be time consuming and may vary between physicians. iSeg uses AI to analyze computed tomography (CT) images and generate a proposed tumor outline that can then be reviewed and modified by the treating physician during radiation treatment planning which may help improve accuracy and provide more consistent results and better planning. iSeg may be safe and effective to use during radiation treatment planning for patients with lung tumors.
